meta.name: service-mesh-observability
meta.description: Implement comprehensive observability for service meshes including distributed tracing, metrics, and visualization. Use when setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency issues, or implementing SLOs for service communication.

copy.tagline: 监控服务网格的分布式追踪与指标,快速定位延迟问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在运行微服务架构,想看清服务间的调用链和延迟瓶颈。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor service mesh traces and metrics to fix latency issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run microservices and need clear visibility into service-to-service latency.

howto.what: 当你为 Istio、Linkerd 等服务网格搭建可观测性时,Claude 会讲解分布式追踪、指标与仪表盘、SLO 定义等做法,并指明存放具体模板和示例的参考文件。
howto.when: 当你在搭建服务网格监控、排查延迟与错误问题,或为服务间通信定义 SLO 时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我给 Istio 网格配置分布式追踪和指标仪表盘
say.note: 它给出追踪与指标的具体做法

say.text: 我的服务间调用延迟很高,帮我定位瓶颈
say.note: 按延迟、错误率等信号帮你排查

say.text: 帮我为服务间通信定义 SLO 和告警阈值
say.note: 给出黄金信号与阈值建议

howto.what_en: When you set up observability for a service mesh like Istio or Linkerd, Claude walks through distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and SLO definitions, and points you to a reference file with concrete templates and worked examples.
howto.when_en: Use it when you are setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency and error issues, or defining SLOs for service-to-service communication.

say_en.text: Set up distributed tracing and metrics dashboards for my Istio mesh
say_en.note: It gives tracing and metrics steps

say_en.text: My service-to-service latency is high, help me find the bottleneck
say_en.note: Uses golden signals to locate it

say_en.text: Help me define SLOs and alert thresholds for service communication
